name: SketchUp控制
description: 通过 SketchUp Ruby 扩展发送命令；仅有一个在线连接时直接使用，多个连接时按动作触发窗口定位。

inputs.name: 操作类型
inputs.description: 发送给选定 SketchUp 连接的命令；多个连接时按动作触发窗口定位。

inputs.name: 功能分类
inputs.condition: 仅：common

inputs.name: 选择功能
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection")

inputs.name: 视图功能
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view")

inputs.name: 场景功能
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "scene")

inputs.name: 整理功能
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize")

inputs.name: 变换功能
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "transform")

inputs.name: 文件功能
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "file")

inputs.name: 持久ID列表
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "selection.select_by_ids")

inputs.name: 选择模式
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "selection.select_by_ids"、"selection.select_all"、"selection.select_same_type"、"selection.select_same_component"、"selection.select_same_tag")

inputs.name: 包含隐藏对象
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "selection.select_all"、"selection.invert"、"selection.select_same_type"、"selection.select_same_component"、"selection.select_same_tag")

inputs.name: 包含锁定对象
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "selection.select_all"、"selection.invert"、"selection.select_same_type"、"selection.select_same_component"、"selection.select_same_tag")

inputs.name: 返回完整详情
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "selection.get_info")

inputs.name: 隐藏对象
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "entity.visibility.set")

inputs.name: 锁定对象
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "selection" 且 selectionOperation 为 "selection.lock")

inputs.name: 标准视图
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.standard")

inputs.name: 切换后缩放到全部
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.standard")

inputs.name: 相机位置 X,Y,Z
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.set_camera")

inputs.name: 观察目标 X,Y,Z
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.set_camera")

inputs.name: 向上向量 X,Y,Z
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.set_camera")

inputs.name: 透视投影
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.set_camera"、"view.projection.set")

inputs.name: 视野角度
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.set_camera"、"view.projection.set")

inputs.name: 场景名称
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "scene" 且 sceneOperation 为 "scene.activate"、"scene.create"、"scene.update"、"scene.rename"、"scene.delete"、"scene.reorder")

inputs.name: 新名称
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "scene" 且 sceneOperation 为 "scene.rename")

inputs.name: 新位置（从0开始）
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "scene" 且 sceneOperation 为 "scene.reorder")

inputs.name: 标签名称
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "tag.set_visibility"、"selection.assign_tag")

inputs.name: 可见
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "tag.set_visibility")

inputs.name: 材质名称
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "selection.assign_material")

inputs.name: 清除材质
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "selection.assign_material")

inputs.name: 对象名称
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 ((commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "entity.rename") 或 (commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.make_group"、"selection.make_component")))

inputs.name: 属性字典
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "entity.set_attribute")

inputs.name: 属性名称
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "entity.set_attribute")

inputs.name: 属性值(JSON)
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "organize" 且 organizeOperation 为 "entity.set_attribute")

inputs.name: 移动向量 X,Y,Z
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.move")

inputs.name: 变换原点 X,Y,Z（留空使用选择中心）
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.rotate"、"selection.scale")

inputs.name: 旋转轴 X,Y,Z
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.rotate")

inputs.name: 旋转角度（度）
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.rotate")

inputs.name: 缩放比例 X,Y,Z
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.scale")

inputs.name: 坐标与长度单位
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 ((commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.set_camera") 或 (commonCategory 为 "transform" 且 transformOperation 为 "selection.move"、"selection.rotate"、"selection.scale")))

inputs.name: 文件路径
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 ((commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.write_image") 或 (commonCategory 为 "file" 且 fileOperation 为 "model.save_as"、"model.export")))

inputs.name: 图片宽度
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.write_image")

inputs.name: 图片高度
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "view" 且 viewOperation 为 "view.write_image")

inputs.name: 导出选项(JSON object)
inputs.condition: (operation 为 "common" 且 commonCategory 为 "file" 且 fileOperation 为 "model.export")

inputs.name: 插件命令菜单文字
inputs.condition: 仅：extension_command.invoke

inputs.name: 所属扩展名称
inputs.condition: 仅：extension_command.invoke

inputs.name: 命令提示文字
inputs.condition: 仅：extension_command.invoke

inputs.name: 高级定位信息(JSON object)
inputs.description: 命令工具生成动作时自动保留状态栏文字和图标等定位信息；手工配置通常留空即可。
inputs.condition: 仅：extension_command.invoke

inputs.name: Ruby 代码
inputs.description: 直接在目标 SketchUp 的 Ruby 上下文中执行。可使用 model、selection、view 和 args。
inputs.condition: 仅：script.evaluate

inputs.name: Ruby 文件路径
inputs.description: 要运行或加载的 Ruby 文件绝对路径。
inputs.condition: 仅：script.run_file, script.load_file

inputs.name: Action 字符串或数字 ID
inputs.description: 原样传给 Sketchup.send_action，不限制 action 内容。
inputs.condition: 仅：host_action.send

inputs.name: Bridge 命令名称
inputs.description: 发送任意命令名称，供第三方插件或后续 Bridge handler 使用。
inputs.condition: 仅：command.custom

inputs.name: 参数(JSON object)
inputs.description: 传入 Ruby 脚本或自定义命令的参数。
inputs.condition: 仅：script.evaluate, script.run_file, command.custom

inputs.name: 在匿名模块中加载
inputs.description: 对应 Ruby load(path, true) 的 wrap 参数。
inputs.condition: 仅：script.load_file

inputs.name: 最长等待时间(ms)
inputs.description: 等待目标 SketchUp 实例返回结果的最长时间。

outputs.name: 命令结果
outputs.description: SketchUp 返回的 JSON 结果。

items.name: [插件] 调用第三方插件命令
[脚本] 运行 Ruby 文件
[脚本] 加载 Ruby 文件
[命令] 发送任意 SketchUp Action
[高级] 发送自定义 Bridge 命令
选择当前上下文全部对象
